title: Rectitude Holdings Secures Over S$10 Million in AIMS Contract Orders Amid Surging Demand for Green Energy Solutions
summary: Rectitude secured more than S$10 million in rental and sales contract orders for its AIMS during the second half of fiscal year 2026 with additional orders under negotiation.
